## Checklist

- [ ] Added a changeset (`pnpm changeset`) if this change should be released.
      For changes that don't need a release (docs, CI, tests), add an empty one: `pnpm changeset --empty`.
- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (e.g. `feat: ...`, `fix: ...`).
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` pass locally.
